cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The treasure map ends at a wall. Our real mission was to wake it. Knock with me; I taught you a firmer knock than that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nothing. Our torch is nearly out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the map brought us here to listen in darkness. I'm putting the torch out. Keep your hands still; you always rattled the kit when I took you diving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can only hear you breathing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Breath control. That's what the map was testing. I'm holding mine; count for me, the way I taught you before your first dive.

reason: Replace or remove the detached explanatory phrase identified in actual rereading, preserving the concrete task and causal response.
